Furthermore, the plea of the respondent no. 3 / Insurance Company regarding delay of three days in registration of FIR also does not become fatal to the case of the petitioners.
There is no dispute to the proposition that even if the FIR has not been lodged regarding the accident, a claim petition can be considered by the Tribunal and compensation can be awarded.

In motor accident claim petitions, lodging of an FIR is not material, if the involvement of the vehicle in the said accident is established by the evidence of the parties and no adverse inference can be drawn against the claimant's case out of the failure of the police to investigate the matter.
(Reliance is placed on the Judgment of the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Allahabad in the case titled "New India Assurance Co. Ltd. Vs. Kaushalya Devi & Ors., 2016 ACJ 70").
